mapper.select: SELECT expense_date `date`, SUM( expense_amount ) amount, expense_type expenseType FROM daily_expense_record WHERE expense_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND del_flag = 0 GROUP BY expense_date, expense_type

SELECT parent.id AS parent_id, parent.category_name AS parent_category, IFNULL( SUM( daily.expense_amount ), 0 ) AS expenseTotal, COUNT( daily.expense_amount ) expenseCount FROM base_tally_category parent LEFT JOIN base_tally_category child ON child.parent_id = parent.id OR parent.id = child.id LEFT JOIN daily_expense_record daily ON daily.category_id = child.id AND daily.expense_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} WHERE parent.parent_id = 0 AND parent.expense_type = 1 GROUP BY parent.id, parent.category_name ORDER BY parent.id;
